description:
MAKE THE MOST OF CRUCIAL FIRST IMPRESSIONS

In any ‘face-to-face’ business environment – meetings, business fayres, conferences and networking events – first impressions are still vital.

The ‘tool’ most used in these situations to create that all-important first impression is the humble business card – a staple requirement in
business etiquette. Business card printing is still money well spent – surveys show that, in these business situations,

if you don’t offer, or have, a business card when asked, people automatically judge you – and your business – as ‘unprofessional’ – not the
impression you want to give!
